verdict.rationale: Resend documents a broad API surface: sending, batch, domains, webhooks, suppressions, API keys, broadcasts, segments and received emails. It also publishes an OpenAPI spec, and its docs and changelog repeatedly state that dashboard actions are also available via the API, CLI, SDKs and MCP server. However, there is no explicit statement of full UI-to-API parity, and several dashboard features have no API evidence. missing for 10: explicit parity commitment, API evidence for dashboard-only features (Vercel integration, activity visualization, SSO/team management, template editing), independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can add and verify a domain you own in four ways: in the Domains Dashboard page, using the Resend API, with a Resend CLI command, or with the Resend MCP server
